proposed_target: Je ne veux pas que tu le dises à qui que ce soit.
proposed_english: I don't want you to tell it to anybody.

note: ça is impersonal/that/it here; English 'this' introduces a demonstrative not present in French.
proposed_target: J'ai l'impression que ça va mal se terminer.
proposed_english: I feel like it's going to end badly.

note: n'en avoir rien à faire means not care at all; English 'don't really care' is weaker.
proposed_target: J'ai l'impression que tu n'en as rien à faire de moi.
proposed_english: I feel like you don't care about me at all.

note: ce magasin means 'this store'; English says 'that store'.
proposed_target: J'ai un ami qui travaille dans ce magasin.
proposed_english: I have a friend who works at this store.

note: missions is more directly tasks/assignments; English adds 'to do' absent from French.
proposed_english: I have a lot of tasks today.

note: devrais faire means 'should do'; English progressive 'should be doing' adds aspect.
proposed_target: Je n'ai aucune idée de ce que je devrais faire.
proposed_english: I have no idea what I should do.

note: ce livre means 'this book', not 'the book'.
proposed_target: Je n'ai pas d'argent pour acheter ce livre.
proposed_english: I have no money to buy this book.

note: un dictionnaire means 'a dictionary', not 'the dictionary'.
proposed_target: Je n'ai pas d'argent pour acheter un dictionnaire.
proposed_english: I have no money to buy a dictionary.

proposed_target: Je n'ai pas le temps de l'expliquer en détail.
proposed_english: I have no time to explain it in detail.

note: For clear mathematical learner English, dix fois plus de is best rendered 'ten times as many', avoiding ambiguous 'ten times more'.
proposed_target: J'ai dix fois plus de livres que tu en as.
proposed_english: I have ten times as many books as you do.

note: Use unambiguous multiplicative English rather than 'three times more'.
proposed_target: J'ai trois fois plus de livres que toi.
proposed_english: I have three times as many books as you do.

note: rentrer means go/come home or return, not 'go inside'.
proposed_target: Je dois rentrer faire mes devoirs.
proposed_english: I have to go home and do my homework.

note: n'aurons pas is future; preserve the future modal relation.
proposed_target: J'espère que nous n'aurons pas à vendre notre maison.
proposed_english: I hope we won't have to sell our house.

note: n'aurons pas is future; preserve it in English.
proposed_target: J'espère que nous n'aurons pas à attendre trop longtemps.
proposed_english: I hope we won't have to wait too long.

note: aimerez is future; English present 'like' drops that tense.
proposed_target: J'espère que vous aimerez ce que j'ai fait pour vous.
proposed_english: I hope you'll like what I made for you.

note: tous vous dire merci is awkward word order; use standard vous dire merci à tous.
proposed_target: Je veux simplement vous dire merci à tous.
proposed_english: I just want to say thanks to you all.
